Sorab Bedi Denies Dating Malaika Arora!

Date:

Sorab Bedi Denies Dating Malaika Arora!

Rumours move fast in showbiz, and lately the internet has been busy linking Malaika Arora with multiple people. After her split from Arjun Kapoor, the actor has been rumoured to be dating diamond merchant Harsh Mehta.

Sorab Bedi Denies Dating Malaika Arora!

Discover more
Celeb
Book Movie Tickets
Celebs

But recently, another name entered the conversation after some viral photos showed her sharing a cosy moment with Sorab Bedi, who gained popularity from Splitsvilla X6. It quickly sparked dating rumours online. Now, Sorab has finally cleared the air.

Talking about how he first met Malaika, Sorab explained that their connection goes way back through mutual friends.

(Also Read: Who Is Harsh Mehta? All About Malaika Arora’s Rumoured Boyfriend!)

He shared, “Delnaz Daruwala and Vahbiz Mehta gave me a chance to walk the ramp during my modelling days. I became friends with them and started going out for parties. At one of the parties, I met Malaika (Arora) through my mentors. She is also a close friend of Delnaz and Vahbiz. Hence, Malaika and I became friends.”

And for those wondering if there is something more going on, Sorab made it crystal clear.

“There is nothing between us.”

He also addressed the constant speculation surrounding their friendship. Sorab said people have been overthinking their bond, even though they have been part of the same social circle for years.

According to him, they have attended many parties together before as well. The only difference now is that he has become a recognisable face, so their pictures and videos are attracting more attention. He added that two people can simply be friends, but many people are quick to assume otherwise.

Who Is Harsh Mehta; Malaika Arora’s Rumoured Boyfriend?

Meanwhile, Malaika has also been making headlines due to rumours about Harsh Mehta. The 33-year-old Mumbai businessman comes from an affluent family and works as a diamond merchant. He also serves as the Managing Director of Sancus Management.

Malaika Arora Past Romances –

For those who forgot, Malaika was earlier married to Arbaaz Khan for 18 years before their divorce in 2017. She later dated Arjun Kapoor from 2018 to 2024.
